ASSURANCE / IDENTITY MAPPINGS

Where does each world reach?

The cross promises a world. This report shows what is deliberately shared, what is connected to identity, and where that promise remains unfinished.

Equal output never implies intentional invariance. Missing and undecided relationships remain open work.

Discovered beyond the inventory

The algebra scans the entire generated homepage and each identity homepage. New text, links, images, metadata, appearance and behaviour attributes can reopen undecided work without adding an inventory row first.

4281 observed relationships · 4112 undeclared observations in 6 review groups.

Equal output never supplies intent. An exact declaration for a container does not classify its children. The complete evidence retains file, token ordinal, element, property and value for every observation.

  • index.html · 1031 observations · 998 undeclared
  • worlds/sourcerer/index.html · 1033 observations · 999 undeclared
  • worlds/author/index.html · 726 observations · 692 undeclared
  • worlds/dad/index.html · 726 observations · 692 undeclared
  • worlds/christian/index.html · 765 observations · 731 undeclared

This scans the five generated homepage documents, not every corpus destination or live DOM state. Comments, doctype and formatting whitespace are excluded. Inline script/style bodies and external script/stylesheet dependencies are opaque and remain undecided unless precisely declared. CSS internals, runtime-only states, shadow DOM, frames and semantic/visual fitness are not certified. Token ordinals are byte-rendering evidence addresses, not stable DOM paths.

The eight decisions

Intent is declared separately from verification. These decisions do not turn structural evidence into a judgment of semantic or visual quality.

Shared-tool exits and explicit perspective changes · Intentionally invariant

The workshop and full-screen reader are shared tools. Identity journeys retain their own return links; leaving the lens is explicit.

Scope: Shared workshop and reader destinations and exit wording; local journey return destinations remain identity-mapped.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Identity URL and selected-world sharing metadata · Identity mapped

A shared link should describe the identity and destination it opens. The cross updates the title, sharing metadata and a link to the selected world.

Scope: Canonical identity home, Threads, Map and Questions URLs, plus the cross’s selected-world permalink and metadata writers.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Structural labels and complete-directory wording · Intentionally invariant

Stable labels make the information architecture recognisable across perspectives. Curated headings, notes, membership and ordering remain identity-mapped.

Scope: Foundation & platform, Applications & programmes, Taking shape, Tools & workbenches, and the full-project directory.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Purpose pigment and selected braid behaviour · Intentionally invariant

A purpose type keeps its colour meaning across identities. The fine metallic braid and slow glisten use the same keyboard and pointer grammar; surrounding surfaces inherit the identity palette.

Scope: Purpose-to-pigment bindings and shared hover/focus braid, reduced-motion and forced-colour rules; not identical background pixels.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Display typography across each world · Identity mapped

Each identity explicitly selects a display font stack. Shared prose and brand fonts remain stable; equal fallback fonts do not imply invariance.

Scope: Headings on identity home, Threads, Map and Questions pages; system fallback font availability is not certified.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Semantic brief, palette family and artwork assignments · Identity mapped

Each world owns a semantic brief and coordinated artwork and palette assignments. Automated checks verify those assignments; human review must still judge their fit.

Scope: Declared briefs, world artwork bindings and the Questions palette family. Structural verification does not certify beauty, interpretation or semantic coherence.

Verification: passed

Required: semantic and visual fit remains a human judgment; this receipt verifies declared assignments.

Common signature, footer copy and external destinations · Intentionally invariant

All perspectives belong to the same person and share the same ownership, contact and stewardship destinations. Compact Map and full editorial footers retain their respective layouts.

Scope: Common footer text and external/assurance links within each page family. Local home return URLs are separately identity-mapped.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

Questions article, artwork and reflection destinations · Identity mapped

Each identity asks a different leading question and supplies its own article, illustration and reflection links. Those links carry the perspective into the readings.

Scope: Identity Questions article text, hero artwork, active daylight palette and authored reflection destinations.

Verification: passed

Automated structural evidence; editorial intent remains an explicit declaration.

What these statuses establish

Intentionally invariant
An explicit scoped policy and reason. A declaration is not a proof over all page descendants.
Identity mapped
All four world values, the runtime data projection and the corresponding cross writer are present.
Missing
Identity variation is expected, but a value or connection is absent. An invariant declaration can also conflict with a cross writer.
Undecided
The intended relationship has not been established. Equal outputs do not resolve it.

Homepage, identity Threads and Maps, forty readings per identity, identity Questions return links, curated application collections, appearance, interaction and footer.

Declared inventory plus automatic generated-output discovery across the entire root homepage and all four identity homepages. Undeclared text and attributes become undecided groups with located evidence; exact declarations do not cover descendants. Nested catalogue output is scanned. External dependencies and inline code bodies stay opaque. This is not exhaustive corpus, DOM, transitive dependency, runtime-state, visual or semantic verification. Existing Threads, Map, reading and eight-decision evidence retain their stated scopes.
